result.instructions: Tools for Bill4Time, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many billable hours did we log last month, by person?"; "Which invoices are still unpaid, and for which clients?"; "Show the time entries for Acme Ltd from this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bill4Time data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bill4time_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bill4time_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bill4time_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bill4time_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bill4time_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (id, name, billing name, email, phone, city, account manager, status, billing rate type, currency). Filter by status, exact client name, id or creation date. Street addresses and tax ids are not returned. GET /clients.

id.description: Only the record with this id.

skip.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip to read the next page.

sort.description: Field to sort by (default: Bill4Time's own order).

descending.description: Sort descending (newest or highest first). Default ascending.

client_name.description: Exact client name (case rules are Bill4Time's).

created_after.description: Clients created on or after this date.

created_before.description: Clients created on or before this date.

include_custom_fields.description: Also return the custom fields (default false).
